title: Terrain, Autotile & Connectivity Grammar
start_authority: Owner Continue freshly verified exact AIOC/application heads, re-read completed MAI-01..03 evidence and resolved the bounded terrain/autotile/connectivity grammar before implementation.
objective: Implement deterministic provider-neutral terrain/autotile/connectivity grammar over completed MAI-02 schema and MAI-03 projection data without creating World topology, gameplay traversability, runtime geometry ownership, importer/resolver/workbench behavior or durable persistence changes.

source_semantics.rule: Normalize only explicitly represented source semantics; preserve unsupported/vendor-specific metadata and never infer missing connectivity.

resolved_contract.terrain_descriptor: Stable terrain IDs and optional semantic owner references describe visual terrain categories independently from selected tile art.

connection_grammar.gridless_rule: Gridless projection has no canonical adjacency ports and returns explicit unsupported-autotile findings.
connection_grammar.channel_rule: Two visual ports connect only when explicit connection channels and compatibility sets agree; adjacency observation alone never creates compatibility.

resolved_contract.autotile_selection: Build deterministic normalized neighbor signatures from explicit local observations; select eligible permitted variants by explicit priority, then stable asset ID and variant ID; preserve explicit unresolved/manual outcomes when no permitted match exists.
resolved_contract.projection_reuse: MAI-03 grid/projection descriptors only interpret local visual neighbor orientation and never create World topology or gameplay truth.

completion_rule: Exact head passed application Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows MAI-04 Validation Core with matching deterministic receipt, and deterministic cross-platform comparison before squash merge. No repair cycle was required.
nonauthorization: World topology/navigation/traversability inferred from visual connectivity
migration 0022 without demonstrated durable schema delta
next_action: MAI-04 is completed_verified with no further implementation authority. MAI-05 may be selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue must freshly verify canonical heads and governed-start MAI-05 before any implementation branch or runtime geometry work exists.
